First, convert 20 weeks and 5 days to days:  
20 weeks × 7 days/week = 140 days  
140 days + 5 days = 145 days subtracted.

Start date: 1207-09-03 (assuming format DD-MM-YYYY, so 3rd September 1207).  
Subtract 145 days:  
September 3 minus 145 days.

Count back:  
From 1207-09-03:  
Back 3 days → 1207-08-31.  
August has 31 days, so back another 31 days → 1207-07-31.  
July has 31 days, so back another 31 days → 1207-06-30.  
June has 30 days, so back another 30 days → 1207-05-31.  
May has 31 days, so back another 31 days → 1207-04-30.  
April has 30 days, so back another 19 days (since we’ve already subtracted 3+31+31+30+31 = 126 days, need 145 total, so 145-126 = 19 more days back from April 30):  
April 30 minus 19 days = April 11, 1207.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1207-04-11
